name: Rootly
summary: Rootly sells incident response and on-call as two products at $20 per user a month each, so a team that wants both pays $40. It has no free plan, and the pricing page does not state the billing period.

facts.text: Routing an alert to a team or service triggers that team's configured escalation policy.
On-call, with paging, rotations and shift swaps, is a separate product from Incident Response, which includes retrospectives and status pages.
Startups under 25 employees can pay what they can, and companies under 100 employees can get up to 50% off.
The page shows SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, GDPR and CCPA badges and does not mention ISO 27001.

plans.name: Incident Response
plans.notes: Billing period not stated. Includes retrospectives and status pages

plans.name: On-Call
plans.notes: Billing period not stated. Paging, rotations and shift swaps

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. Adds SCIM and audit logs

hiddenCosts: Incident Response and On-Call are priced separately, so both together cost $40 per user a month.
The FAQ says trials typically last two weeks and can be extended.

security.ssoPlan: SSO and SAML on the listed plans; SCIM on Enterprise
